Actor.description:
Who wrote a record or acted: the session, the program, the person and
the agent's name, each when known, and at least one. Every record type that names who
acted holds one.

agent.description:
The name the agent was given, such as `nightly scheduler`, as
free text.

person.description: The person who acted, such as `luke`, or their email address.

program.description: The program that acted, such as `claude-code` or `codex`.

description:
`params/value/v1`: the value an agent derived by running a heuristic, at
`/params/values/<name>`, the same `<name>` as its heuristic. With
`data` `too-little`, readers use the heuristic's default.

data.description: Whether the run found enough data.

derived.description: When the agent ran the heuristic.

evidence.description:
The run of `/suites/params-<name>` that holds the inputs and the
check the agent measured.

scopes.description:
The value for each repository or project, by its path, such as
`/repos/board`.

value.description: The value for any scope `scopes` does not list.

title: ValueRecord
